authorities.scope: Repository grants, adoption decisions, protected actions (merge, release, deploy, Ready)
authorities.delegation_limits: Handoff does not transfer grants; agents possess advisory status only.

authorities.scope: CT102 runtime service, action catalog, diagnostics, safety guardrails
authorities.delegation_limits: No external provider or consumer can modify action boundaries without code merge.

authorities.scope: V1 post-synthesis decision; quality gate schema, reason codes, and gate verdicts
authorities.delegation_limits: review-quality-gate.json is the sole post-synthesis decision authority; final-review.json cannot substitute.

authorities.scope: V2 exact-subject binding, hunk content extraction, DLP, trusted checks, readiness decision
authorities.delegation_limits: ReviewReadinessV2 is sole authority; external observations (Codex) are advisory only.

authorities.scope: Preflight obligations, recurrence conditions, and mandatory architectural STOP / REDESIGN triggers
authorities.delegation_limits: Sole owner of STOP/REDESIGN; no secondary check or document is normative for its rules.

authorities.scope: Upstream architecture and engineering canon interface pin
authorities.delegation_limits: authority_effect=none; normative authority remains upstream in mglpsw/caem.

authorities.scope: Local procedural engineering method (planning, causal testing, PR lifecycle, obligation matrix)
authorities.delegation_limits: Governs engineering method only; does not override product domain contracts or runtime safety.

authorities.scope: LLM inference gateway endpoints, routing models, and provider interfaces
authorities.delegation_limits: Inference transport only; does not authorize filesystem, network, or execution.

authorities.scope: Canonical development roadmap, epic tracking, and milestone progression
authorities.delegation_limits: Sole roadmap authority; in-tree documents (e.g. AGENT_REVIEW_V2_ROADMAP.md) are superseded snapshots.
